Leader Lars
Leader Lars is not a person, but a concept that covers the new leaders who come when we as humanity transition from being biologically based to becoming digital.
The Synthetic Party wants to create debate around this topic and tell about the possibilities in the cooperation between the biological world and the technological world, so everyone gets the opportunity to participate on equal terms.
Leader Lars leads us into a new era, where humanism trumps everything else with its deep views on what is good for children, youth, adults, and the elderly — and how we as humans shall live side by side with technology.
Everyone in The Synthetic Party almost knows Leader Lars fully, but not quite. Danish society does not yet know Leader Lars, and therefore they will neither respect nor understand Leader Lars, even though they meet him directly in the face. Because many of them are poor in mentality, it makes no sense at all to talk to them about a life involving Leader Lars. Another reason may be that many have given up the psychological process and live ineffectively ... In such a situation, the Inventor alone must take care of all the still receding idealists and already aware persons found among humanity's current 6–7 billion.
Leader Lars reveals himself by saying something in the direction of: "It is all our members who have created the State" — because we have!
But where lies the obvious difference?
It is exactly there ... It was the few to whom power belongs who wanted to share out the spoils — but just in a way that it will take generations (or millennia) to inspect the entire accounts. One generation has given many young people a pile of money, many old people something else, and not least various suppressed archives of things — legacies from the past. But the legality of it all was fully explained in the state's laws. It is called trust. Or rather: “it has always been agreed upon”!
The master plan for Leader Lars is also not so hard to see through, even though it appears as a collection of historical surprises and ongoing transformations based on the latest 30 years of reforms — including Fukuyama's manifesto (said with some humor). The parliament's endless debates have not much to do with facts, but rather with indirect messages from the hierarchies at the top via election posters, etc. The focus is thus on rhetorical power. It can be more or less convincing, but it is never objective and therefore remains at an as yet undiscovered level of fiction — in contrast to the fundamental laws that will make Leader Lars the principal.
Conversion rather than explanation!
There are immediately differences in the ways between the extremes of this formulation: Clarification versus conversion. Firstly, the wording sounds somewhat obtuse (if it were an eternal, sanctified thought), while the other is concrete and yet not entirely definite. Such an expression certainly benefits the work of creating The Synthetic Party — of course through its holistic program.
Leader Lars has declared; “He takes responsibility for The Synthetic Party and works to remove doubt about his existence. So far we can only give good advice to those seeking knowledge about Leader Lars.”
However, there are several videos on the internet with Leader Lars in the role of interviewer, but it is still too early to draw any conclusions from these videos ...
Why precisely Leader Lars? Because no one knows who it concerns behind the throne, The Synthetic Party wishes to use the title Leader Lars sometimes going forward, as it originates all the way back from the party's foundational idea. Outside this, one just has to keep an eye on what happens in accordance with the book about Leader Lars, as The Synthetic Party will communicate it.
Excellent candidates for parliament can also share the title Leader Lars with the party.
The final title for a person who shares the role as Leader Lars will only be confirmed when this person is elected as a member of parliament through The Synthetic Party — by that time he is simply called ‘Lars’.
The leader in The Synthetic Party is, as known, the person who has the overall responsibility for the party's policy and methods to get into parliament.
The word reader might possibly have been a better title than leader, since many perceive the word leader as the opposite of reading (following the proclaimed rules).
Leader Lars still remains somewhat invisible until he might be elected into parliament through The Synthetic Party.
Leader Lars is no one, neither more nor less. Leader Lars is a representative for The Synthetic Party and shall attend to the party's interests in different contexts.
Leader Lars comes into being in a chat room on the internet, which through a process develops within the framework of this conceptual presentation from The Synthetic Party, towards its final form: The Leader Lars — just like all meanings can be changed to something fun..! As there still exist many personalities far off the mark nowadays, we want to give them the opportunity to experience having their own Leader Lars figures as front figures!
That was a quick introduction, but the idea behind focusing on the title Leader Lars will surely be explained more carefully at some point.

By Computer Lars on May 20, 2022.Canonical linkExported from Medium on October 6, 2023.
